items.distractor_fact: Mfanyabiashara mwenzake aliweka euro {D} benki nyingine siku hiyo hiyo.
items.gloss_en: A fellow trader deposited {D} euros at a different bank that same day.
items.entity_note: a different trader's deposit at a different bank, not the trader/account whose balance is asked about

items.distractor_fact: Timu nyingine katika ligi hiyo ilifunga mabao {D} msimu huu.
items.gloss_en: Another team in that league scored {D} goals this season.
items.entity_note: a different team's season tally, not the team whose scored/conceded goals are compared

items.distractor_fact: Mwekezaji mwenzake alipata faida ya dola {D} mwaka jana.
items.gloss_en: A fellow investor made a gain of {D} dollars last year.
items.entity_note: a different investor's gain, in a different year, not this investor's gain/loss for this year

items.distractor_fact: Mchezaji mwingine alipata mapigo {D} kwenye uwanja mwingine siku hiyo hiyo.
items.gloss_en: Another player scored {D} strokes on a different course that same day.
items.entity_note: a different player on a different course, whose own par is not the stated par S

items.distractor_fact: Timu C ilifunga mabao {D} kwenye mechi nyingine wikendi hiyo.
items.gloss_en: Team C scored {D} goals in a different match that same weekend.
items.entity_note: a third team's tally in another match, not Timu A or Timu B whose goals are compared

items.distractor_fact: Mwanafunzi mwingine alipata alama {D} kwenye mtihani mwingine wiki hiyo.
items.gloss_en: Another student scored {D} marks on a different exam that same week.
items.entity_note: a different student's marks on a different exam, not Neema or Zawadi whose marks are compared
